rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: A Megadeus!
rows.display_text: 「A Megadeus!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: You've come at last, Big Duo! Now, let's show these people a taste of your tremendous power!
rows.display_text:
「You've come at last, Big Duo! Now, let's
show these people a taste of your
tremendous power!」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: This is no time to be frozen with fear. We're getting out of here.
rows.display_text:
「This is no time to be frozen with fear.
We're getting out of here.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: B-but, wouldn't it be dangerous to go outside...?
rows.display_text:
「B-but, wouldn't it be dangerous to go
outside...?」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Are you going to let Schwarzwald destroy this house full of memories?
rows.display_text:
「Are you going to let Schwarzwald
destroy this house full of memories?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Besides, it'll be fine. The sun is rising.
rows.display_text: 「Besides, it'll be fine. The sun is rising.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The sun...
rows.display_text: 「The sun...」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Daitarn, come here!
rows.display_text: 「Daitarn, come here!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Nngh!
rows.display_text: 「Nngh!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Change, Daitarn 3!!
rows.display_text: 「Change, Daitarn 3!!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: For the world, for its people, Daitarn 3 crushes the ambitions of evil!
rows.display_text:
「For the world, for its people, Daitarn 3
crushes the ambitions of evil!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: The solar disc... the sun...! So, light, is it!
rows.display_text:
「The solar disc... the sun...! So, light, is
it!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Schwarzwald. Your eccentric acts end here.
rows.display_text:
「Schwarzwald. Your eccentric acts end
here.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Eccentric, you say?
rows.display_text: 「Eccentric, you say?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Stirring up people's anxieties with delusions and proclaiming the world's ruin -- a place in the sun doesn't suit someone like you.
rows.display_text:
「Stirring fear with delusions and
proclaiming ruin -- a place in the sun
doesn't suit you.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Go back quietly to the place that suits you... the darkness!
rows.display_text:
「Go back quietly to the place that suits
you... the darkness!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Darkness... the thing people have feared since the dawn of time. The origin that swallows everything whole...
rows.display_text:
「Darkness... the thing people have feared
since the dawn of time. The origin that
swallows everything whole...」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: People turn their eyes away from that fear, and behave as though its existence were never even part of their own history.
rows.display_text:
「People turn from that fear, acting as
though it were never part of their own
history.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: But that is where the truth lies! No... darkness itself is the truth! It is the answer to this world!
rows.display_text:
「But that is where the truth lies! No...
darkness itself is the truth! It is the
answer to this world!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I have no intention of debating you. But you, the wreck of what was once a newspaper reporter... your misreporting will be corrected.
rows.display_text:
「I won't debate you. But you, a wrecked
ex-reporter... your misreporting will be
corrected.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Even if this world is mired in chaos, what waits beyond it is not the darkness you speak of...!
rows.display_text:
「Even if this world is mired in chaos,
what waits beyond it is not the darkness
you speak of...!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: As long as I'm here, that will never be the truth!
rows.display_text:
「As long as I'm here, that will never be
the truth!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Very well, Child of the Sun! If you believe your light can illuminate the darkness, then show me!
rows.display_text:
「Very well, Child of the Sun! If you
believe your light can illuminate the
darkness, then show me!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: I will correct your arrogance by striking you down -- with this Big Duo!
rows.display_text:
「I will correct your arrogance by
striking you down -- with this Big Duo!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Just what I wanted...! Banjo Haran and Daitarn 3 will drag it all out into the light of day!
rows.display_text:
「Just what I wanted...! Banjo Haran and
Daitarn 3 will drag it all out into the
light of day!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: What is this...!?
rows.display_text: 「What is this...!?」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: A Megadeus Archetype...!
rows.display_text: 「A Megadeus Archetype...!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Relics of the Black History being excavated all over the world!
rows.display_text:
「Relics of the Black History being
excavated all over the world!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: It seems the slumbering ghosts, drawn by the Big Duo, have awoken.
rows.display_text:
「It seems the slumbering ghosts, drawn
by the Big Duo, have awoken.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: What do you think, Child of the Sun? Fragments showing the truth lie buried all over this world.
rows.display_text:
「What do you think, Child of the Sun?
Fragments showing the truth lie buried all
over this world.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: The Black History, is it...
rows.display_text: 「The Black History, is it...」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: This is the world's truth. Face that darkness!
rows.display_text:
「This is the world's truth. Face that
darkness!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I refuse...!
rows.display_text: 「I refuse...!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: What...!?

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I told you already. I will sweep away the darkness!
rows.display_text:
「I told you already. I will sweep away
the darkness!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: If this junk is a fragment of the truth you speak of, then all I have to do is smash it to pieces!
rows.display_text:
「If this junk is a fragment of the
truth you speak of, then all I have to do
is smash it to pieces!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: How disappointing. So you too are a fool who turns his eyes from the truth.
rows.display_text:
「How disappointing. So you too are a
fool who turns his eyes from the truth.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Then you will disappear here. Be swallowed by the darkness, never knowing where this world is headed!
rows.display_text:
「Then you will disappear here. Be
swallowed by the darkness, never knowing
where this world is headed!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's enough of your ravings!
rows.display_text: 「That's enough of your ravings!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Mr. Negotiator. I've been waiting for you.
rows.display_text:
「Mr. Negotiator. I've been waiting for
you.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It's been a while, the Storm. Not since Japan, was it?
rows.display_text:
「It's been a while, the Storm. Not since
Japan, was it?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry for leaving you to deal with Schwarzwald.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry for leaving you to deal with
Schwarzwald.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Don't worry about it. I was getting fed up with him myself.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. I was getting fed
up with him myself.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: So you've come, Roger Smith. As I thought, you too were drawn to the truth.
rows.display_text:
「So you've come, Roger Smith. As I
thought, you too were drawn to the
truth.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm simply on a carefree journey. I only stopped in this city because of some mechanical trouble with Big O.
rows.display_text:
「I'm simply on a carefree journey. I only
stopped in this city because of some
mechanical trouble with Big O.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: And what if that was the Big's guidance?
rows.display_text:
「And what if that was the Big's
guidance?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What...?
rows.display_text: 「What...?」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Because this is the land where a fragment of the being that destroys the world's laws once was.
rows.display_text:
「Because this is the land where a
fragment of the being that destroys the
world's laws once was.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That bandaged man... he knows about the Coralian...!
rows.display_text:
（That bandaged man... he knows about
the Coralian...!）

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Why did you try to eliminate Captain Dominic and the rest of us?
rows.display_text:
「Why did you try to eliminate Captain
Dominic and the rest of us?」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Those who feel no fear before great power... to think they could control such a thing is no different from turning your back on the truth.
rows.display_text:
「Those who feel no fear before great
power -- believing they could control it
is no different from denying the truth.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: That is why I show my power! So that people never forget how to fear!
rows.display_text:
「That is why I show my power! So that
people never forget how to fear!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm sick and tired of your ravings and your eccentric ways. If meeting you here is some kind of fate, I'll put it to use.
rows.display_text:
「I'm sick and tired of your ravings and
your eccentric ways. If meeting you here
is some kind of fate, I'll put it to use.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Schwarzwald! Go back to the darkness that is your home!
rows.display_text:
「Schwarzwald! Go back to the darkness
that is your home!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Can you manage that -- with your Big?
rows.display_text: 「Can you manage that -- with your Big?」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Master Roger... that man seems to be aware of Big O's trouble.
rows.display_text:
「Master Roger... that man seems to be
aware of Big O's trouble.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: All weapons disabled, huh. I have to admit, this one has me beat.
rows.display_text:
「All weapons disabled, huh. I have to
admit, this one has me beat.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: No need to worry, young Roger. I'll keep working on repairing your machine right where it is.
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry, young Roger. I'll
keep working on repairing your machine
right where it is.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: But, Mr. Thurston...
rows.display_text: 「But, Mr. Thurston...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I can't just let some fool go on rampaging around my house!
rows.display_text:
「I can't just let some fool go on
rampaging around my house!」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I have to protect the house my grandson will come home to!
rows.display_text:
「I have to protect the house my
grandson will come home to!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...Understood. I'll trust your skill.
rows.display_text: 「...Understood. I'll trust your skill.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I'll take on that guy for the time being. Finish the repairs while I do.
rows.display_text:
「I'll take on that guy for the time
being. Finish the repairs while I do.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: And here I made such a grand entrance, only to end up in this sorry state...
rows.display_text:
「And here I made such a grand entrance,
only to end up in this sorry state...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry, Banjo Haran. I'll have to rely on you for a bit.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Banjo Haran. I'll have to rely on
you for a bit.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: You who turn your eyes from the truth! Taste your own powerlessness!
rows.display_text:
「You who turn your eyes from the truth!
Taste your own powerlessness!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: How pathetic, Roger Smith! It seems the Big has run out of patience with you!
rows.display_text:
「How pathetic, Roger Smith! It seems the
Big has run out of patience with you!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O is my partner. But I have no intention of needlessly deifying it, the way you do...!
rows.display_text:
「Big O is my partner. But I have no
intention of needlessly deifying it, the
way you do...!」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: That's right, young Roger! A mech is not some magic tool!
rows.display_text:
「That's right, young Roger! A mech is
not some magic tool!」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: But the soul that dwells within it will never betray the one who tended and cherished it!
rows.display_text:
「But the soul that dwells within it will
never betray the one who tended and
cherished it!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mr. Thurston...
rows.display_text: 「Mr. Thurston...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Just a bit more...! Just a bit more and your mech will get its power back!
rows.display_text:
「Just a bit more...! Just a bit more and
your mech will get its power back!」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: If you protect Big O, Big O will always answer you!
rows.display_text:
「If you protect Big O, Big O will always
answer you!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Of course. Big O has never betrayed my trust.
rows.display_text:
「Of course. Big O has never betrayed my
trust.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Those words... So you really are the Dominus of the Big.
rows.display_text:
（Those words... So you really are the
Dominus of the Big.）

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: A transmission...? In a place like this...?
rows.display_text:
「A transmission...? In a place like
this...?」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: It's been a while, No. 340.
rows.display_text: 「It's been a while, No. 340.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Vera Ronstadt...!
rows.display_text: 「Vera Ronstadt...!」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: Your reports have been lagging lately, so I was a little worried, but you look well enough.
rows.display_text:
「Your reports have been lagging lately,
so I was a little worried, but you look
well enough.」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: We've sent our forces your way. Partly to test the power of the Big, as well.
rows.display_text:
「We've sent our forces your way. Partly
to test the power of the Big, as well.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: The Union is beginning direct action...!
rows.display_text: 「The Union is beginning direct action...!」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: You have no right to question our strategy.
rows.display_text:
「You have no right to question our
strategy.」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: Just move as ordered. Don't forget that betraying the organization means death, No. 340.
rows.display_text:
「Just move as ordered. Don't forget
that betraying the organization means
death, No. 340.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Reinforcements!?
rows.display_text: 「Reinforcements!?」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: A collaborator of that fool who plays king in that city...!
rows.display_text:
「A collaborator of that fool who plays
king in that city...!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The one who plays king... Alex Rosewater...!
rows.display_text:
「The one who plays king... Alex
Rosewater...!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Watch out, Roger! That strange robot is targeting Big O!
rows.display_text:
「Watch out, Roger! That strange robot is
targeting Big O!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Damn it...! Evade!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it...! Evade!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Guh...!

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Roger!
rows.display_text: 「Roger!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: This is... bad, isn't it!
rows.display_text: 「This is... bad, isn't it!」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Rest assured, Master Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Rest assured, Master Roger.」

rows.speaker: Garrison
rows.en: Please leave it to us.
rows.display_text: 「Please leave it to us.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That old man's got a bazooka!?
rows.display_text: 「That old man's got a bazooka!?」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Well done, Master Garrison. That's a good angle you've got there.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, Master Garrison. That's a
good angle you've got there.」

rows.speaker: Garrison
rows.en: No, no... it's you, Master Norman, landing a direct hit on the drive unit -- that's the impressive one.
rows.display_text:
「No, no... it's you, Master Norman,
landing a direct hit on the drive unit --
that's the impressive one.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: I won't let you have Roger or Big O.
rows.display_text: 「I won't let you have Roger or Big O.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: And now the girl has a missile launcher!?
rows.display_text:
「And now the girl has a missile
launcher!?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Nice one, Garrison!
rows.display_text: 「Nice one, Garrison!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry, Norman. And you too, Dorothy.
rows.display_text: 「Sorry, Norman. And you too, Dorothy.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Don't worry about it. Besides, that thing can still move.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. Besides, that
thing can still move.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: All right! Repairs complete! Young Roger! Hit it with everything you've got!
rows.display_text:
「All right! Repairs complete! Young
Roger! Hit it with everything you've got!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Thank you, Mr. Thurston!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, Mr. Thurston!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The old man's giving it his all...! I can't afford to lose either!
rows.display_text:
「The old man's giving it his all...! I
can't afford to lose either!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O, action!!
rows.display_text: 「Big O, action!!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What a hair-trigger tune-up this is!!
rows.display_text: 「What a hair-trigger tune-up this is!!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: So this is the Thurston style!!
rows.display_text: 「So this is the Thurston style!!」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Give it everything, young Roger! Big O will answer you!
rows.display_text:
「Give it everything, young Roger! Big O
will answer you!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Understood, Mr. Thurston. I send my thanks and respect to your skill.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Mr. Thurston. I send my
thanks and respect to your skill.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Well then, shall we go, Mr. Negotiator?
rows.display_text: 「Well then, shall we go, Mr. Negotiator?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Schwarzwald... and you, Alex's so-called collaborator!
rows.display_text:
「Schwarzwald... and you, Alex's so-called
collaborator!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I will walk the path I've chosen! If you're going to get in my way, be ready to pay the price!
rows.display_text:
「I will walk the path I've chosen! If
you're going to get in my way, be ready
to pay the price!」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: I see... so that's the power of the Big.
rows.display_text: 「I see... so that's the power of the Big.」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: No. 340, return to Kizz Munt's side at once. We're moving the plan forward.
rows.display_text:
「No. 340, return to Kizz Munt's side at
once. We're moving the plan forward.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: ...Understood.
rows.display_text: 「...Understood.」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: Don't forget, No. 340. Those born into the Union are fated to obey the Union.
rows.display_text:
「Don't forget, No. 340. Those born into
the Union are fated to obey the Union.」

rows.speaker: Vera
rows.en: All that awaits those who forget that is death.
rows.display_text:
「All that awaits those who forget that
is death.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Thurston. You really saved us.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you very much, Mr. Thurston. You
really saved us.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: It just so happened the parts I had on hand were usable, that's all.
rows.display_text:
「It just so happened the parts I had on
hand were usable, that's all.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Besides, it's I who should be thanking you.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, it's I who should be thanking
you.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: After all, you protected the house that belongs to me and my grandson.
rows.display_text:
「After all, you protected the house that
belongs to me and my grandson.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Memories... So that's what fills that house.
rows.display_text:
「Memories... So that's what fills that
house.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Once you get old, those become a fortune of their own. Though someone as young as you might not understand that yet...
rows.display_text:
「Once you're old, that becomes a
fortune--something you're too young yet
to understand...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: From here on, you can make as many memories as you like, and pile them up...
rows.display_text:
「From here on, you can make as many
memories as you like, and pile them up...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Youth itself is the future.
rows.display_text: 「Youth itself is the future.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Those words... I'll take them gratefully.
rows.display_text: 「Those words... I'll take them gratefully.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: ...That said, as long as this body keeps moving, I still think I've got plenty of life left in me.
rows.display_text:
「...That said, as long as this body keeps
moving, I still think I've got plenty of
life left in me.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Quite right.
rows.display_text: 「Quite right.」

rows.speaker: Garrison
rows.en: Just as you say.
rows.display_text: 「Just as you say.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: ...This time, I take my hat off to their careers.
rows.display_text:
「...This time, I take my hat off to their
careers.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Colonel Dewey, Anemone... My stay in this city looks like it's going to be a long one.
rows.display_text:
（Colonel Dewey, Anemone... My stay in
this city looks like it's going to be a
long one.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The man who raised that Renton... Axel Thurston. He's a bigger man than I expected.
rows.display_text:
（The man who raised that Renton... Axel
Thurston. He's a bigger man than I
expected.）

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Hey, Renton... I wonder if a day will come when I get to tell you a story like this too...
rows.display_text:
（Hey, Renton... I wonder if a day will
come when I get to tell you a story like
this too...）

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I'll wait patiently. To someone young like you, this Bellforest probably looks like it has nothing in it at all...
rows.display_text:
（I'll wait patiently. To someone young
like you, this Bellforest probably looks
like it has nothing in it at all...）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: This is the end, Schwarzwald!
rows.display_text: 「This is the end, Schwarzwald!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: This isn't the end... no, I cannot end here!
rows.display_text:
「This isn't the end... no, I cannot end
here!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Then tell us. What that 'truth' of yours actually means.
rows.display_text:
「Then tell us. What that 'truth' of
yours actually means.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: I exist alongside this Big Duo in order to make the truth known. But I have no intention of revealing its full scope.
rows.display_text:
「I exist alongside this Big Duo in order
to make the truth known. But I have no
intention of revealing its full scope.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You just keep saying whatever you please...!
rows.display_text:
「You just keep saying whatever you
please...!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Because what I must do is instill fear in people.
rows.display_text:
「Because what I must do is instill fear
in people.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Schwarzwald...
rows.display_text: 「Schwarzwald...」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Fear... it is something necessary for creatures as weak as we are!
rows.display_text:
「Fear... it is something necessary for
creatures as weak as we are!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: When people stop fearing, the human race wanders into a dead end...
rows.display_text:
「When people stop fearing, the human
race wanders into a dead end...」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: and becomes nothing more than a pitiful thing, waiting for its own extinction without even a shred of feeling.
rows.display_text:
「and becomes nothing more than a pitiful
thing, waiting for its own extinction
without even a shred of feeling.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: And then people will come to know it. The days of humanity's end, as depicted in the novel written by a young Gordon Rosewater...
rows.display_text:
「Then people will know it: the days of
humanity's end, as told in the novel a
young Gordon Rosewater wrote.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: And then, in order to start everything over, the Executor awakens...
rows.display_text:
「And then, in order to start everything
over, the Executor awakens...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The Executor...?
rows.display_text: 「The Executor...?」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Fear...! And face it! That is exactly what is needed to make people truly human!
rows.display_text:
「Fear...! And face it! That is exactly
what is needed to make people truly
human!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: In the end, we never did learn what he means by 'truth'...
rows.display_text:
「In the end, we never did learn what he
means by 'truth'...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: But this much is clear.
rows.display_text: 「But this much is clear.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: At the very least, I have no intention of accepting whatever 'truth' that man speaks of.
rows.display_text:
「At the very least, I have no intention
of accepting whatever 'truth' that man
speaks of.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Child of the Sun! That arrogance of yours, fearing nothing at all, is the most contemptible thing about you!
rows.display_text:
「Child of the Sun! That arrogance of
yours, fearing nothing at all, is the most
contemptible thing about you!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: This is just my own policy, you see. Even if you say that, I can't very well stop now.
rows.display_text:
「This is just my own policy, you see.
Even if you say that, I can't very well
stop now.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Then let me teach you! The truth of this world... the terror of the eternal darkness!
rows.display_text:
「Then let me teach you! The truth of
this world... the terror of the eternal
darkness!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I'm sick of riddles. If you're a newspaper reporter too, then sum up what you want to say clearly and concisely!
rows.display_text:
「I'm sick of riddles. If you're a
newspaper reporter too, then sum up what
you want to say clearly and concisely!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: Roger Smith...! You claim to seek the truth, yet all you're doing is running from that darkness!
rows.display_text:
「Roger Smith...! You claim to seek the
truth, yet all you're doing is running
from that darkness!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I alone decide what the truth I seek means. I don't need you sticking your nose in.
rows.display_text:
「I alone decide what the truth I seek
means. I don't need you sticking your
nose in.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: That's exactly what I mean by running away! The power of the Big is too much for a man like you to handle!
rows.display_text:
「That's exactly what I mean by running
away! The power of the Big is too much
for a man like you to handle!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I said I don't need you sticking your nose in, Schwarzwald!
rows.display_text:
「I said I don't need you sticking your
nose in, Schwarzwald!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I don't know what you think happened between me and Big O in the past, but I'm living in the present!
rows.display_text:
「I don't know what you think happened
between me and Big O in the past, but
I'm living in the present!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: If someone comes to threaten that, I have no intention of refusing to use my strength! Especially not for someone I can't even reason with!
rows.display_text:
「If someone threatens that, I won't
refuse to use my strength -- especially
not someone I can't reason with!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...This happened a little while after I parted ways with you all in Japan.
rows.display_text:
「...This happened a little while after I
parted ways with you all in Japan.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: That was around when $c was split into two, right?
rows.display_text:
「That was around when $c was split
into two, right?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I was continuing my carefree travels with Norman and Dorothy.
rows.display_text:
「I was continuing my carefree travels
with Norman and Dorothy.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: And then we headed south down the Gallia continent and arrived in Bellforest.
rows.display_text:
「And then we headed south down the
Gallia continent and arrived in Bellforest.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Bellforest... The city where we ran into the Seven Swell phenomenon.
rows.display_text:
「Bellforest... The city where we ran into
the Seven Swell phenomenon.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's right. It's also the place where young Renton was born and raised, and where he met Miss Eureka.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. It's also the place where
young Renton was born and raised, and
where he met Miss Eureka.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What business could you possibly have had in a city with absolutely nothing in it?
rows.display_text:
「What business could you possibly have
had in a city with absolutely nothing in
it?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: 'Nothing in it' isn't quite the right way to put it. At the very least, it's not a phrase that should come from you.
rows.display_text:
「'Nothing in it' isn't quite the right way
to put it. At the very least, it's not a
phrase that should come from you.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Well then, let me tell you about the passionate men Roger and I encountered there.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, let me tell you about the
passionate men Roger and I encountered
there.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Bellforest...
rows.display_text: （Bellforest...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Remote as it is, it's no exaggeration to say the transformation of our world began in this city...
rows.display_text:
（Remote as it is, it's no exaggeration to
say the transformation of our world began
in this city...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: It was through the fighting in this city that type ZERO dramatically improved its performance.
rows.display_text:
（It was through the fighting in this
city that type ZERO dramatically improved
its performance.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: What's especially noteworthy is that this is also the city where the Seven Swell phenomenon was confirmed for the first time since the Summer of Love...
rows.display_text:
（Notably, this city also saw the first
Seven Swell phenomenon since the Summer
of Love...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The many phenomena that seemed like coincidence...
rows.display_text:
（The many phenomena that seemed like
coincidence...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: But given the fact that boy... Renton, is the son of Adroc Thurston...
rows.display_text:
（But given the fact that boy... Renton,
is the son of Adroc Thurston...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: It can be said that everything has begun to take on the appearance of inevitability.
rows.display_text:
（It can be said that everything has
begun to take on the appearance of
inevitability.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I have to find out. The role given to that boy... to Renton Thurston...
rows.display_text:
（I have to find out. The role given to
that boy... to Renton Thurston...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Whatever it is that was entrusted to that boy... for that reason as well...
rows.display_text:
（Whatever it is that was entrusted to
that boy... for that reason as well...）

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Would you be the one who came looking for me?
rows.display_text:
「Would you be the one who came looking
for me?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: How do you do, Mr. Axel. I'm Dominic Sorel.
rows.display_text:
「How do you do, Mr. Axel. I'm Dominic
Sorel.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Young Renton was a great help to me.
rows.display_text: 「Young Renton was a great help to me.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Well now... so you're an acquaintance of his.
rows.display_text:
「Well now... so you're an acquaintance of
his.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: He asked me, if I ever went near Bellforest, to please look in on you, Mr. Thurston...
rows.display_text:
「He asked me, if I ever went near
Bellforest, to please look in on you, Mr.
Thurston...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Is that so. Well, well... I'm sorry you went to the trouble.
rows.display_text:
「Is that so. Well, well... I'm sorry you
went to the trouble.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: It's nothing much, but if you don't mind, please stay at my place. No need to hold back.
rows.display_text:
「It's nothing much, but if you don't
mind, please stay at my place. No need to
hold back.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: This was the man I had to meet... Axel Thurston... him, of all people...
rows.display_text:
（This was the man I had to meet... Axel
Thurston... him, of all people...）

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: ...I see, so young Dominic here travels all over the world.
rows.display_text:
「...I see, so young Dominic here travels
all over the world.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Yes... I belong to the army's surveying unit, and I go out to various places to map this multiverse.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... I belong to the army's surveying
unit, and I go out to various places to
map this multiverse.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: But this is a world where even the terrain changes. Even my superiors tell me it's fine to handle the assignment loosely.
rows.display_text:
「But this is a world where even the
terrain changes. Even my superiors tell me
it's fine to handle the assignment loosely.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Is that so. Well then, make yourself at home.
rows.display_text:
「Is that so. Well then, make yourself at
home.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: So, in the course of that travel, you met Renton too?
rows.display_text:
「So, in the course of that travel, you
met Renton too?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Yes. He's still young, but he's a solid, dependable boy.
rows.display_text:
「Yes. He's still young, but he's a solid,
dependable boy.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: He's still nothing but a chick. I doubt he's changed that much in the few months since he left this house.
rows.display_text:
「He's still nothing but a chick. I doubt
he's changed that much in the few months
since he left this house.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Are you waiting here for his return, Mr. Thurston?
rows.display_text:
「Are you waiting here for his return,
Mr. Thurston?」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: It's not quite that, but I don't have anywhere else to go, either.
rows.display_text:
「It's not quite that, but I don't have
anywhere else to go, either.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I just do my work here as a mechanic.
rows.display_text: 「I just do my work here as a mechanic.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I see...
rows.display_text: 「I see...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Just as the rumors say, Mr. Thurston is conservative... or to put it more bluntly, he seems to be a stubborn old man.
rows.display_text:
（Just as rumored, Mr. Thurston is
conservative... or more bluntly, he seems
to be a stubborn old man.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Asking him directly about Renton or Adroc doesn't seem like a wise move.
rows.display_text:
（Asking him directly about Renton or
Adroc doesn't seem like a wise move.）

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Would this be Garage Thurston?
rows.display_text: 「Would this be Garage Thurston?」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: That's right, but are you here for a repair job?
rows.display_text:
「That's right, but are you here for a
repair job?」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Yes. My name is Norman Burg, and I serve as a certain person's butler.
rows.display_text:
「Yes. My name is Norman Burg, and I
serve as a certain person's butler.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: R. Dorothy Wayneright. I've come to bring you along.
rows.display_text:
「R. Dorothy Wayneright. I've come to
bring you along.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: What an impatient young lady. Still, though...
rows.display_text:
「What an impatient young lady. Still,
though...」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Something wrong...?
rows.display_text: 「Something wrong...?」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I'd like to think I've picked up my share of manners along with my years, but let me say just one thing.
rows.display_text:
「I'd like to think I've picked up my
share of manners along with my years,
but let me say just one thing.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: As a fellow craftsman, let me pay my respects to whoever created you, young lady.
rows.display_text:
「As a fellow craftsman, let me pay my
respects to whoever created you, young
lady.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: ...Thank you. I think he would have been glad to hear those words.
rows.display_text:
「...Thank you. I think he would have
been glad to hear those words.」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: So... since you've come to fetch me, I take it this is a repair request after all?
rows.display_text:
「So... since you've come to fetch me, I
take it this is a repair request after
all?」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Yes. But bringing the mech itself here is, unfortunately, rather difficult...
rows.display_text:
「Yes. But bringing the mech itself here
is, unfortunately, rather difficult...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: I see. So that's why you've come to guide me there instead.
rows.display_text:
「I see. So that's why you've come to
guide me there instead.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Would you be willing to take on the job?
rows.display_text:
「Would you be willing to take on the
job?」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: I can handle general maintenance myself, but this time there happen to be parts I simply can't get hold of...
rows.display_text:
「I can handle general maintenance myself,
but this time there happen to be parts I
simply can't get hold of...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Understood. There's also the respect I owe that young lady of yours. Let's make this a special house call.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. There's also the respect I
owe that young lady of yours. Let's make
this a special house call.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Thank you very much.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you very much.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: I think Big O will be glad too.
rows.display_text: 「I think Big O will be glad too.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Big O, did she say...? Then these two... are they connected to the Negotiator I've heard rumors about...?
rows.display_text:
（Big O, did she say...? Then these two...
are they connected to the Negotiator I've
heard rumors about...?）

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: Sorry, young Dominic. It seems I have to go out for a while.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, young Dominic. It seems I have
to go out for a while.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That's fine, but...
rows.display_text: 「That's fine, but...」

rows.speaker: Axel
rows.en: It's just a lazy old man living alone here, but make yourself at home as though it were your own.
rows.display_text:
「It's just a lazy old man living alone
here, but make yourself at home as
though it were your own.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Understood. Then I'll look after the place while you're out.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. Then I'll look after the
place while you're out.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Alone in this house, huh... This is a chance too good to pass up...
rows.display_text:
（Alone in this house, huh... This is a
chance too good to pass up...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: ...No good... Even after searching the whole house, I can't find anything worth noting.
rows.display_text:
「...No good... Even after searching the
whole house, I can't find anything worth
noting.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That old man... is he trying to completely forget about his own son Adroc, and his grandson Renton...?
rows.display_text:
「That old man... is he trying to
completely forget about his own son
Adroc, and his grandson Renton...?」

rows.en: Is that so?
rows.display_text: 「Is that so?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Waaugh!
rows.display_text: 「Waaugh!」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Oh my? You're awfully jumpy for a burglar.
rows.display_text:
「Oh my? You're awfully jumpy for a
burglar.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: W-who are you!? How did you get in here!? What do you want!?
rows.display_text:
「W-who are you!? How did you get in
here!? What do you want!?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Bombarding a lady with questions like that -- that's rather poor manners.
rows.display_text:
「Bombarding a lady with questions like
that -- that's rather poor manners.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The Storm...! Banjo Haran!
rows.display_text: 「The Storm...! Banjo Haran!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: You seem to know my name, Special Duty Captain Dominic Sorel. In that case, I suppose introductions are unnecessary for either of us.
rows.display_text:
「You know my name, Special Duty Captain
Dominic Sorel. Then introductions are
unnecessary for either of us.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: Well then, Captain. Let me answer your questions.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, Captain. Let me answer your
questions.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: My name is Angel. I rang the bell at the front door, but no one answered, so I let myself in.
rows.display_text:
「My name is Angel. I rang the bell at
the front door, but no one answered, so I
let myself in.」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: I've come to see Mr. Axel Thurston, who I understand lives here.
rows.display_text:
「I've come to see Mr. Axel Thurston,
who I understand lives here.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I met her in Bellforest, actually...
rows.display_text: 「I met her in Bellforest, actually...」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I imagine she and I... and you as well, came here for the same purpose.
rows.display_text:
「I imagine she and I... and you as well,
came here for the same purpose.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Banjo Haran... A mysterious figure whose movements even military intelligence can't trace...
rows.display_text:
「Banjo Haran... A mysterious figure whose
movements even military intelligence can't
trace...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The purpose behind his actions is unknown. However, he's designated an S-class target as an activist opposed to the New Earth Federation government.
rows.display_text:
「His purpose is unknown, but he's an
S-class target as an activist opposed to
the New Earth Federation.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I don't have any intention of denying the New Earth Federation as a whole. Though the corruption in parts of it does make me want to hold my nose.
rows.display_text:
「I don't mean to deny the New Earth
Federation entirely. Though its corruption
makes me want to hold my nose.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: It'd gall me to leave you misunderstanding, though... As a memento of our meeting, let me tell you about my purpose.
rows.display_text:
「It'd gall me to leave you
misunderstanding... As a memento of our
meeting, let me explain my purpose.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: What...!?

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: My purpose... is to crush the ambitions of evil, for the sake of the world and its people.
rows.display_text:
「My purpose... is to crush the ambitions
of evil, for the sake of the world and
its people.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Is he just an airhead...? But...
rows.display_text: （Is he just an airhead...? But...）

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Do you understand now?
rows.display_text: 「Do you understand now?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: He seems to mean it...!
rows.display_text: （He seems to mean it...!）

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Now then, it's my turn to ask the questions.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, it's my turn to ask the
questions.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I'd like you to tell me everything you know about the Ageha Plan.
rows.display_text:
「I'd like you to tell me everything you
know about the Ageha Plan.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I hear the military is pursuing something called the Coralian, based on what Adroc Thurston is said to have left behind.
rows.display_text:
「I hear the military is chasing something
called the Coralian, based on what Adroc
Thurston reportedly left behind.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: And apparently, the Coralian threatens the very existence of this world.
rows.display_text:
「And apparently, the Coralian threatens
the very existence of this world.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Though even I couldn't quite grasp what it actually is.
rows.display_text:
「Though even I couldn't quite grasp what
it actually is.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: W-what are you talking about!? I haven't the faintest idea!
rows.display_text:
「W-what are you talking about!? I
haven't the faintest idea!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Relax, Captain Dominic. I have no intention of getting rough with you.
rows.display_text:
「Relax, Captain Dominic. I have no
intention of getting rough with you.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: So instead, I want to appeal to your conscience.
rows.display_text:
「So instead, I want to appeal to your
conscience.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Isn't keeping information about the Coralian hidden something that does this world no good?
rows.display_text:
「Isn't keeping information about the
Coralian hidden something that does this
world no good?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: This is just a hunch of mine, but it seems like the situation is too big to be decided by the judgment of just a few people.
rows.display_text:
「This is just a hunch, but the situation
seems too big to be decided by just a
few people's judgment.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: So shouldn't the information be made public promptly, and humanity's collective wisdom brought together to deal with it...?
rows.display_text:
「Shouldn't the info be made public
promptly, and humanity's wisdom brought
together to deal with it...?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Shut up...! There are people who understand the situation without needing to hear it from the likes of you!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up...! There are people who
understand the situation without needing
to hear it from the likes of you!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Colonel Dewey Novak, is it.
rows.display_text: 「Colonel Dewey Novak, is it.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: If you already understand that much, then don't stick your nose in any further...!
rows.display_text:
「If you already understand that much,
then don't stick your nose in any
further...!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Colonel Dewey is acting to save both humanity and the world!
rows.display_text:
「Colonel Dewey is acting to save both
humanity and the world!」

rows.en: How foolish...!
rows.display_text: 「How foolish...!」

rows.speaker: Angel
rows.en: You're...!
rows.display_text: 「You're...!」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: To know the truth, and yet keep it for yourself alone, is a great sin.
rows.display_text:
「To know the truth, and yet keep it for
yourself alone, is a great sin.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: W-what is this man!? A mummy!?
rows.display_text: 「W-what is this man!? A mummy!?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Michael Seebach... Or should I say, Schwarzwald.
rows.display_text:
「Michael Seebach... Or should I say,
Schwarzwald.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: You seem to know who I am.
rows.display_text: 「You seem to know who I am.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Not that I ever had the slightest wish to meet you.
rows.display_text:
「Not that I ever had the slightest wish
to meet you.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: It seems you're just as arrogant a man as the one I once knew.
rows.display_text:
「It seems you're just as arrogant a man
as the one I once knew.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Thank you for the overly generous compliment.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you for the overly generous
compliment.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: You arrogant, insolent man... Turning your eyes from the truth is a great sin.
rows.display_text:
「You arrogant, insolent man... Turning
your eyes from the truth is a great sin.」

rows.speaker: Schwarzwald
rows.en: That is why I convey the truth... the terror of darkness. That is my mission!
rows.display_text:
「That is why I convey the truth... the
terror of darkness. That is my mission!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Gramps...
rows.display_text: 「...Gramps...」

rows.speaker: Garrison
rows.en: Master Renton... Mr. Thurston is waiting for you back in that city.
rows.display_text:
「Master Renton... Mr. Thurston is waiting
for you back in that city.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Though he also said this -- that he'll wait for you for as long as it takes.
rows.display_text:
「Though he also said this -- that he'll
wait for you for as long as it takes.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Thank you. I... intend to see this through to the very end before I go back to that city.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you. I... intend to see this
through to the very end before I go back
to that city.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Of course, when I do, it'll be together with Eureka...
rows.display_text:

with Eureka...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: So you've traveled to all sorts of places across this multiverse, Mr. Roger.
rows.display_text:
「So you've traveled to all sorts of
places across this multiverse, Mr. Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It was a journey in search of something... In other words, the same as you, young Kira Yamato.
rows.display_text:
「It was a journey in search of
something... In other words, the same as
you, young Kira Yamato.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You could say the many encounters I had along the way are what shaped who I am now.
rows.display_text:

had along the way are what shaped who I
am now.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I understand... because it's the same for me.
rows.display_text:
「I understand... because it's the same
for me.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Please, tell us more, Mr. Roger. I want to know about this world... and about the people who live in it.
rows.display_text:
「Please, tell us more, Mr. Roger. I want
to know about this world... and about the

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Yeah. We've been so busy fighting, we never had time to think about this world.

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Understood. It'll make for a decent way to pass the time, and a good opportunity besides.
rows.display_text:

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Been waiting for this! Give us something flashy to kick off the space-time restoration!
rows.display_text:

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Let's see... Then let me tell you about some men I met right in the middle of this world.
